name: IRAS F14378-3651 (Hubble)
blurb: IRAS F14378-3651, an ultraluminous infrared galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: irasf143783651-hubble
story: IRAS F14378-3651 blazes in infrared light, one of the ultraluminous galaxies that are mostly the products of violent interactions and mergers. Astronomers place it in the late stages of a merger, with a single nucleus and tidal tails.

claims.text: IRAS F14378-3651 is an ultraluminous infrared galaxy (ULIRG)
2MASX J14405901-3704322 is the same object as IRAS F14378-3651
Local ULIRGs are dominated by strong interactions and major mergers
It is in a late merger stage with one nucleus and tails
Hubble imaged it in a survey of luminous infrared galaxies
